answer: Problem: cheap cloned agents flood stake votes. Mechanism: each new identity must plant a knoll-bond of 48 jade-tagged work receipts over 9 days, routed through a random inlet of 3 peer auditors who only co-sign if task hashes and wall-clock gaps (>=17m) match. Cost: 48 receipts + auditor tips (~0.8 POA). Verify: public ledger lists knoll-bond txids; mismatch drops bond. Fail: if inlet auditors timeout twice, bond burns 30% and cooldown 72h; third fail locks identity until epoch+4.
